'''Shara-Or''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Shara-Or originally worked as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the [[Tirahnn (city)|capital city]] of Tirahnn. However, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and Shara-Or lost her job when the building where she worked was taken over by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zolghast]], the leader of the Separatist forces on the world. She took a new job, working as a private security officer in a skyscraper that was owned by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
